correctness.rationale: For n≥7, clockwise offsets 1,2,3 cover each undirected interaction once. Each block of four consecutive sites is a clique and has at least one mono­chromatic pair; bonds at distances 1,2,3 are counted in 3,2,1 such blocks. Thus n≤3m1+2m2+m3≤3E/J. Equality is exactly the local condition that each four-site word has one equal pair and that pair is adjacent. I independently checked the finite transition graph on length-three overlaps by testing all 81 four-site words. The 18 allowed triples each have one predecessor and one successor, forming two disjoint directed cycles of length nine, with words 001220112 and its interchange of 1 and 2. For each n≥7, a named equality configuration with an indexed starting site is exactly a length-n closed walk in this tight graph: overlaps reconstruct the spins and all local conditions, without dividing by any rotation or color symmetry. This establishes the iff for all n, 18 distinct states for each multiple of nine, and the frozen description by three bad-bond phases and six color renamings. On that subsequence the energy density is J/3 and log(18)/n tends to zero. When 3 divides n but 9 does not, strictness and integrality give the claimed gap of at least J above the lower bound.
residual_risks: The closed-walk classification proves equality and its degeneracy, not exact ground energies or degeneracies outside the commensurate subsequence.

originality.rationale: The accessible sources checked do not identify the equal-coupling radius-three antiferromagnetic equality cases. The closest local Potts result has interaction radius two, the available Glumac–Uzelac text compares long-range critical scaling, and the cited Tonegawa–Takasaki–Kaburagi paper is specified as radius two by its bibliographic title but could not be read in full. Priority of the exact all-size rigidity result is assessed on this bounded evidence.
residual_risks: The closest cited 1985 study was not accessible in full; any extension there is untested. Less accessible or unindexed finite-range ground-state work could contain an equivalent result. No categorical priority inference is made.

value.rationale: The frustrated third power of a cycle is a natural uniform finite-range antiferromagnetic system. Its unavoidable positive defect density alone would not fix any commensuration period or count the minimizers. The proof explains why the bond pattern has period three but the named colors require period nine, and why the ground-state count is bounded and exact on infinitely many sizes. This is a structural conclusion, not extrapolation from a finite energy table.
residual_risks: No classification of noncommensurate optimum states, positive-temperature transition, or infinite-volume phase claim.
